title: Performance Analyst
description:
Performance Analyst - Northampton - Finance

Competitive Salary + Bonus + Excellent Benefits

Looking to build a career with a leading trade merchant that puts its people first?

At Highbourne Group, we supply trade professionals and retail customers with everything from boilers and tubing to full bathroom suites and towel rails. We’re proud of our quality reputation and ambitious plans for the future - and we know our success starts with our team. That’s why we create a culture where you’re backed from day one, given the tools to thrive, and supported to build a long-term, rewarding career.

Why Work With Us?

We offer a complete perks package designed to support your work life, personal life, and future growth:

  • Competitive base pay, scheme-based bonuses, retail discounts, cashback savings, and personal financial support options.
  • Dedicated Mental Health First Aiders, an Employee Assistance Programme, life assurance, and a team culture where we genuinely look out for one another.
  • Extended family leave policies (including maternity and paternity), additional holiday options, and flexible working arrangements.
  • Full structured onboarding, ongoing training, and an inclusive workplace culture that values individuality and gives you space to progress.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Gathering, manipulating, and consolidating complex data from multiple sources, including our data lake, HRIS (iTrent), spreadsheets, and various departments.
  • Acting as our data quality gatekeeper by identifying discrepancies, pinpointing missing information, and correcting calculation errors.
  • Translating and formatting validated information for seamless upload into our central finance and accounting systems.
  • Reconciling final results to guarantee total accuracy.
  • Building and maintaining robust processes, controls, and reporting to ensure our bonus data exercises can be repeated reliably and efficiently.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Proven experience gathering and understanding large datasets.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (including complex formulas, lookups, and pivot tables) combined with sharp analytical skills and a flawless eye for numerical accuracy.
  • The ability to confidently interpret bonus schemes and accurately apply various calculation methodologies.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across different business units and systems.

This is an initial 6month Fixed Term Contract with the potential for extension or made into a perm role.

It is a full-time role working 40 hours per week, Monday - Friday. We offer flexible working arrangements.

READY TO APPLY?

Hit apply today to start your journey with Highbourne Group.

Take full pride in your daily routes, vehicle compliance, and general branch support.

#BelongWithUs

We’re passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that celebrates and values diversity. Bring your whole self to work regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, *** or sexual orientation. We don’t want you to ‘fit’ our culture, we want you to enrich it.

We are committed to best practices in recruitment and undertake Basic Criminal Record Disclosures for candidates that are offered employment within our branches that undertake deliveries for British Gas. This check will only be undertaken after the acceptance of an offer of employment.
